transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It's very nice to meet you. Thank you for fitting me in. I hope I'm not wasting your time... I'm just here because, well, it's been going on for nearly two years now. I'm just so sure that the contractor we hired, and maybe some of the people on my block, are quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts and they give all these excuses, but... I just know it. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right.

You mentioned being sure that the contractor and some neighbors are working against you. Has anyone been able to convince you otherwise, or does it feel like no matter what they say, you just know it's true?

I know I probably sound so stubborn, Doctor... I really don't mean to be a difficult person. I've always tried to get along with everyone. But... well, to answer your question, no. Nobody has been able to convince me otherwise. 

Like I was saying just a moment ago, my husband tries so hard. He'll sit me down and point at all the receipts, and the contractor always gives him these perfectly polite excuses for why the work is still half-wrong. But I just... I just know it's not an accident. No matter what they say, I know they really have been working together to cheat us for two years now. 

I hate thinking this way about people on my own block, I really do. I don't want you to think I'm just some bitter old woman making a fuss. It makes me sound awful to say I don't believe my own husband's paperwork, doesn't it? I hope I'm answering your question okay... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you had any other experiences or beliefs, similar to this one, where you felt certain something was happening even when others couldn't see it that way?

Oh, um... no, Doctor. I really don't think so. I'm not the kind of person who goes around making up stories or looking for trouble everywhere, I promise. 

It's really just this one thing with the kitchen and the neighbors. Everything else in my life is... well, it's perfectly normal. I get along fine with the girls at my book club, and I've never had any issues at the grocery store or anything like that. I'm usually very trusting! Maybe too trusting sometimes. 

I hope that's the right answer. I just don't want you to think I'm losing my mind or seeing things that aren't there all the time. It's just this one specific situation that I know is happening. Does that make sense?
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others around you didn’t seem to notice?

Oh, goodness, no. No, nothing like that, Doctor. I've never heard voices or seen things that aren't there. I know sometimes people who... well, people who need to see a doctor like you might have those sorts of experiences, but I certainly haven't. 

I'm just a regular person, really. My hearing is actually starting to go a little bit, if I'm being honest! But no, I don't sense things that other people don't. It's just the facts of what they're doing with my kitchen. I hope that's what you were asking? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of everything. I'm definitely not imagining things out of thin air.
